title: Pro-government support marches reported in March publication but held on 25 February
reason: The source dates the multi-province support marches to 25 February and describes support for the sitting President. The event began outside March and is pro-government, not a protest against the state.
notes: Retained as an off-month false lead; publication on 6 March does not change event onset. Different province sites are not combined for turnout.
